stories.hook: ¿Puede la estimulación magnética acelerar la recuperación depresiva?
stories.headline: La estimulación magnética transcraneal intermitente es tan eficaz como la convencional en depresión
stories.finding: El consenso actualizado indica que la estimulación magnética transcraneal repetitiva (rTMS) es segura y eficaz para la depresión, y que la variante de burst theta intermitente (iTBS) no es inferior a la rTMS estándar. Estrategias emergentes como iTBS acelerado, guía por resonancia magnética y moduladores de neuroplasticidad presentan hallazgos prometedores.
stories.takeaway: Este dato orienta a los clínicos a adoptar protocolos de iTBS, que reducen la duración de las sesiones sin perder eficacia, y sugiere que la personalización mediante neuroimagen y moduladores podría optimizar la respuesta terapéutica en depresión resistente.
stories.paperTitle: Consensus review and considerations on TMS to treat depression: A comprehensive update endorsed by the National Network of Depression Centers, the Clinical TMS Society, and the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
stories.originalAbstract: • Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a safe and effective treatment for depressive disorders. • New forms of rTMS such as intermittent theta burst (iTBS) are non-inferior to standard rTMS for treating depression. • Attempts to enhance efficacy (accelerated iTBS, MRI guidance, neuroplasticity modulators) show promising early findings. This article updates the prior 2018 consensus statement by the National Network of Depression Centers (NNDC) on the use of transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) in the treatment of depression, incorporating recent research and clinical developments. Publications on TMS and depression between September 2016 and April 2024 were identified using methods informed by PRISMA guidelines. The NNDC Neuromodulation Work Group met monthly between October 2022 and April 2024 to define important clinical topics and review pertinent literature. A modified Delphi method was used to achieve consensus. 2,396 abstracts and manuscripts met inclusion criteria for review. The work group generated consensus statements which include an updated narrative review of TMS safety, efficacy, and clinical features of use for depression. Considerations related to training, roles/responsibilities of providers, and documentation are also discussed. TMS continues to demonstrate broad evidence for safety and efficacy in treating depression. Newer forms of TMS are faster and potentially more effective than conventional repetitive TMS. Further exploration of targeting methods, use in special populations, and accelerated protocols is encouraged. This article provides an updated overview of topics relevant to the administration of TMS for depression and summarizes expert, consensus opinion on the practice of TMS in the United States.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué el contenido no importa en la rumiación?
stories.headline: Nuevo cuestionario mide sensibilidad a pensamientos intrusivos sin depender del contenido
stories.finding: En una muestra de 615 participantes, el Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire mostró una estructura estable de tres factores: experiencia negativa de los pensamientos, conciencia y monitoreo, y percepción de falta de control. El instrumento presentó alta consistencia interna, fiabilidad test‑retest y diferencias significativas según rasgos de personalidad y grupos clínicos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo permite evaluar la vulnerabilidad a la rumiación y a los pensamientos intrusivos más allá de su contenido, facilitando diagnósticos precisos y la personalización de intervenciones cognitivo‑conductuales.
stories.paperTitle: Development and validation of the Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Intrusive thoughts are involuntary mental experiences associated with various psychopathologies and can be disruptive. Although most research on intrusive thoughts focuses on negative content, intrusive thoughts are not defined solely by what they contain. Recent findings suggest that the distress associated with intrusive thoughts is driven more by individual characteristics than by the content of the thoughts themselves. To capture such content-independent individual differences, the present research focuses on the development and validation of the Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire (STIQ). Methods: = 615), the psychometric properties of the STIQ were examined. Analyses assessed factor structure, internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and associations with personality traits and clinical groups. Results: Results supported a stable three-factor structure of the STIQ, reflecting negative experience of thoughts, awareness and monitoring of thoughts, and perceived lack of control over thoughts. The questionnaire demonstrated high internal consistency and test-retest reliability and showed meaningful variance across personality traits and clinical groups, independent of intrusive thought content. Discussion: The findings highlight the utility of the STIQ in capturing a transdiagnostic, content-independent sensitivity to intrusiveness. The STIQ provides a novel tool for examining individual differences and the mechanisms underlying distress associated with intrusive cognitions, contributing to a more comprehensive understanding of intrusiveness in psychological phenomena.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una IA mejorar la entrevista psiquiátrica?
stories.headline: IA entrenada supera al modelo base en entrevistas psiquiátricas
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 60 pares de escenarios (120 encuentros), el agente entrenado con aprendizaje por refuerzo superó al modelo base en el 76,7 % de los pares (p < 0,0001). Además, mejoró la comunicación centrada en el paciente (82,0 % vs 65,2 %) y la adecuación del diagnóstico diferencial (68,3 % vs 33,3 %).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que los modelos de IA entrenados mediante simulación pueden reforzar la calidad de la entrevista clínica, facilitando una mejor comunicación y diagnósticos más precisos, lo que podría transformar la práctica psiquiátrica y la formación de profesionales.
stories.paperTitle: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
stories.originalAbstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la atención plena potenciar la TCC?
stories.headline: Mindfulness mejora la TCC mediante regulación emocional
stories.finding: El estudio siguió a 162 pacientes con depresión y trastornos de ansiedad durante 25 sesiones de TCC individual, evaluando mindfulness, regulación emocional, depresión y ansiedad. El modelado estructural reveló que la reducción de la rumiación mediaba la relación entre mayor mindfulness y disminución de los síntomas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que integrar ejercicios breves de mindfulness en la TCC puede fortalecer la regulación emocional y acelerar la mejoría clínica, orientando a los terapeutas a focalizar la rumiación como objetivo terapéutico.
stories.paperTitle: Emotion Regulation as a Mechanism of Mindfulness in Individual Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy for Depression and Anxiety Disorders
stories.originalAbstract: Background: The global prevalence of depression and anxiety disorders underscores the need for a more profound comprehension of effective treatments. Mindfulness has shown promise in enhancing treatment outcomes and preventing relapse in these conditions, but the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Methods: This study examined the role of emotion regulation as a mediator in the relationship between changes in mindfulness and the reduction of depression and anxiety symptoms during individual cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT). We tracked longitudinal changes in mindfulness, emotion regulation, depression, and anxiety at baseline (pre), early treatment (session 5), midtreatment (session 15), and posttreatment (session 25) in 162 patients with depression and anxiety disorders. Further, we examined whether the effects of mindfulness on emotion regulation could be enhanced by introducing a brief mindfulness intervention at the beginning of each CBT session, as compared to progressive muscle relaxation and individual psychotherapy without any standardized session-introducing interventions. Results: Multilevel structural equation modeling indicated that decreases in rumination and increases in reappraisal and acceptance mediated the relationship between mindfulness and reductions in depressive symptoms. In contrast, reductions in avoidance explained the association between mindfulness and changes in anxiety symptoms. These links remained unchanged when adding a mindfulness intervention into individual CBT. Conclusion: Results support emotion regulatory properties of mindfulness and highlight distinct pathways of symptom reduction in depression and anxiety. These findings have important implications for understanding the mechanisms of mindfulness and tailoring treatment to individual patient needs. This trial is registered with NTC02270073.

stories.hook: ¿Los traumas infantiles alteran la percepción de seguridad?
stories.headline: Los ACE predicen menor neurocepción de seguridad psicológica
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 222 adultos reclutados en Lahore, se evaluó la relación entre experiencias adversas infantiles (ACE) y la neurocepción de seguridad psicológica mediante escalas validadas. Los resultados mostraron que los ACE fueron un predictor significativo de una menor neurocepción de seguridad psicológica.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la seguridad psicológica percibida en adultos está vinculada a traumas tempranos, lo que implica que intervenciones dirigidas a mejorar la neurocepción podrían mitigar efectos de los ACE en contextos laborales y terapéuticos.
stories.paperTitle: Unraveling the Nexus: Investigating the Relationship between Neuroception of Psychological Safety and Childhood Traumas
stories.originalAbstract: This research aims to explore the intricate relationships among neuroception of psychological safety and childhood traumas. Early life experiences, particularly adverse childhood experiences (ACEs), have been shown to impact neurodevelopment and influence later perceptions of psychological safety. This study seeks to build on existing literature by examining these intricate relationships. Analytical cross-sectional design was used to assess the participants at a single point in time. The data gathered throughout Lahore, Punjab from Jan 2024 to July 2024. The sample size of 222 adult participants was selected by the convenience sampling strategy. A diverse sample of adult’s age range of 20 and over recruited to ensure representation of various adult stages, genders, and cultural backgrounds. Assessment of participants was based on established measures and their eligibility for the study was determined accordingly. For assessment purpose three scales were used; Neuroception of Psychological Safety Scale (NPSS) for psychological safety and Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACE) for childhood trauma were used. Adverse childhood experiences measured by ACE to be a significant predictor of neuroception of psychological safety (p<.000) and also significant predictor of all its subscales of social engagement (p<.000), compassion (p<.000) and bodily sensations (p<.000). The results are in line with previous literature linking trauma with Polyvagal theory that Adverse childhood Experiences (ACEs) like violence, physical, emotional and sexual abuse, or being developed with such parents and other family members suffering from the mental health issues or substance abuse history can provide the base for physiological and mental health problems in later life.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la sorpresa predicha curar el trauma?
stories.headline: El trauma como error de predicción no resuelto: una nueva visión neuropsicoanalítica
stories.finding: El libro propone que el trauma es un estado de sorpresa abrumadora en el que los errores de predicción no se resuelven, dejando procesos mentales y neuronales sin atar. Además, sugiere que bajo condiciones favorables esos mecanismos pueden reactivarse en áreas como la sexualidad o el humor, favoreciendo la transformación en lugar de la repetición.
stories.takeaway: Este enfoque sugiere nuevas estrategias terapéuticas que buscan reparar la falla predictiva del trauma, ofreciendo una ruta para transformar experiencias traumáticas en procesos de crecimiento y adaptación.
stories.paperTitle: Neuropsychoanalytic Perspectives on Trauma: Prediction, Violation, Transformation
stories.originalAbstract: In this book, Kobi Tiberg presents a novel neuropsychoanalytic perspective that integrates psychoanalytic theory with contemporary neuroscience, particularly predictive processing, to explore trauma across mind and brain. Building on Freud’s concept of binding, the book examines trauma as a state of overwhelming surprise where prediction errors cannot be resolved, leaving mental and neural processes unbound. It offers a unique dual-aspect approach, addressing both neurological forms of trauma, such as acquired brain injury, and relational developmental trauma, revealing functional links between brain mechanisms and subjective experience. The book provides fresh insights into dissociation, repetition, and post-traumatic adaptation, whilst also exploring how mechanisms underlying trauma – surprise, disruption, and unbinding – may be reengaged under favorable conditions in domains such as sexuality and humor, allowing for transformation rather than mere repetition. Clinical implications are also discussed, offering reflections on how these mechanisms may inform therapeutic practice. Written for clinicians, researchers, and students in psychoanalysis, neuroscience, psychology, and psychiatry, this integrative framework bridges theory and practice, making complex concepts accessible to those working with or studying trauma from multiple perspectives.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la conciencia corporal empeorar los síntomas somáticos?
stories.headline: Mayor conciencia interoceptiva intensifica la relación entre regulación emocional y síntomas somáticos
stories.finding: En una muestra de 394 adultos, las dificultades en la regulación emocional se asociaron positivamente con los síntomas somáticos (r = 0.53, p < 0.001). La conciencia interoceptiva moderó esta asociación, incrementándola (B = 0.069, SE = 0.020, p < 0.001, ΔR² = 0.020).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la atención a la interocepción puede potenciar los efectos negativos de una regulación emocional deficiente, indicando que las intervenciones deben equilibrar la conciencia corporal con estrategias de regulación para evitar el aumento de síntomas somáticos.
stories.paperTitle: The Moderating Role of Interoceptive Awareness in the Relationship Between Difficulties in Emotion Regulation and Somatic Symptoms
stories.originalAbstract: Difficulties in emotion regulation have been associated with greater somatic symptom severity. However, the role of interoceptive awareness in this relationship remains unclear. This study examined whether overall interoceptive awareness and its specific dimensions moderate the association between difficulties in emotion regulation and somatic symptoms. The sample comprised 394 adults recruited from the general population through online participant recruitment platforms. Participants completed the Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale-16, Somatic Symptom Scale-8, and Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness. Moderation analyses were conducted using PROCESS Model 1, controlling for age, gender, and chronic physical illness. These findings showed that difficulties in emotion regulation were positively associated with somatic symptoms (r = 0.53, p < 0.001). Overall interoceptive awareness significantly moderated this association (B = 0.069, SE = 0.020, p < 0.001, ΔR2 = 0.020), such that the association became stronger at higher levels of interoceptive awareness. Following Bonferroni correction, significant moderating effects were also observed for noticing, emotional awareness, self-regulation, and body listening, whereas not distracting, not worrying, attention regulation, and trusting were not significant. Overall, the findings suggest that greater interoceptive awareness may be associated with a stronger relationship between emotion regulation difficulties and somatic symptoms.

stories.hook: ¿Puede un cuestionario mejorar la salud del sueño?
stories.headline: Nuevo cuestionario Bernese evalúa salud del sueño clínicamente
stories.finding: Los autores introducen el Bernese Sleep Health Questionnaire, una herramienta sencilla para evaluar la salud del sueño y detectar trastornos circadianos en la práctica clínica. Argumentan que, junto con ejercicio, dieta y actividades sociales, un sueño adecuado puede disminuir la carga de enfermedades cerebrales, mentales, cardiovasculares, metabólicas y cáncer.
stories.takeaway: Este cuestionario permite una evaluación rápida y estandarizada del sueño en entornos clínicos, facilitando la detección temprana de trastornos y la implementación de intervenciones que pueden prevenir múltiples enfermedades asociadas al sueño insuficiente.
stories.originalAbstract: Together with (physical and mental) exercise, diet, and social activities, sleep is a key health behavior that occupies one third of our lives, yet remains neglected. In the first part of this review, we present the current knowledge on how sleep promotes body, brain, mental, occupational, and social health as well as creativity, productivity, and well-being. In the second part, we discuss how good sleep and screening for sleep–wake disorders may improve health and reduce the burden of brain, mental, cardiovascular, metabolic disorders and cancer. We also review the literature on measurements of sleep health and present the Bernese Sleep Health Questionnaire, a new and simple tool to assess sleep health and screen for sleep–wake circadian disorders in clinical practice.

stories.hook: ¿Los atletas mejoran más con mindfulness adaptado culturalmente?
stories.headline: El entrenamiento MAIC supera al MAC en atletas, según meta‑análisis de 18 ensayos
stories.finding: El meta‑análisis, que incluyó 18 ensayos controlados aleatorios, encontró efectos positivos de ambas intervenciones (MAC y MAIC) en rendimiento deportivo, mindfulness y flexibilidad psicológica. Además, la versión adaptada culturalmente (MAIC) mostró efectos sustancialmente mayores que el MAC.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que adaptar mindfulness‑aceptación a contextos culturales potencia su eficacia, lo que orienta a entrenadores y psicólogos deportivos a personalizar intervenciones para maximizar rendimiento y bienestar psicológico.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring mindfulness interventions across cultures: a comparative meta-analysis of mindfulness interventions for athletes in Western and Eastern contexts
stories.originalAbstract: Objective Applying mindfulness training across cultures can be challenging because its internal motivation depends on values, but there are differences between Western and Eastern contexts. This meta-analysis examines the comparative impacts of the Western Mindfulness-Acceptance-Commitment (MAC) approach and the culturally-adapted Chinese Mindfulness-Acceptance-Insight-Commitment (MAIC) mindfulness training for athletes, to explore the importance of cultural adaptation in cross-cultural psychology to psychological skills training. Methods This meta-analysis was registered with Prospero (ID: CRD42023474474) and adhered to the PRISMA principles. The PICO search methodology was employed to identify pertinent Chinese and English literature across six databases (Web of Science, PubMed, Scopus, CNKI, Wanfang, and VIP) from 2003 to 2023. The evidence originated from randomized controlled trials. Effect sizes were evaluated across three primary domains: athletic performance, mindfulness, and psychological flexibility, and heterogeneity and publication bias. Results Both MAC and MAIC demonstrated positive effects across all outcome categories in 18 studies. MAIC exhibited substantially larger effect sizes compared to MAC. In mindfulness (MAIC: g = 1.273, p < 0.001; MAC: g = 0.521, p = 0.001), sports performance (MAIC: g = 0.945, p = 0.015; MAC: g = 0.550, p < 0.001), MAC did not provide evidence of improved psychological flexibility (g = 0.076, p = 0.747), while MAIC demonstrated significant benefits (g = 0.964, p < 0.001). Discussion While MAIC is based on MAC, it yields more significant outcomes. This may be the “Insight” component introduced by MAIC, which skillfully integrates Eastern context. The MAIC strategy not only becomes more appropriate for local athletes but also indirectly enhances their mindfulness, athletic performance, and psychological flexibility, resulting from cultural adaptation. The new idea not only solves the culture shock caused by the direct application of Western MAC approach on Chinese athletes, but also provides a new solution to the problem that there is insufficient evidence to support the effect of the MAC approach on “psychological flexibility.” Investigating differential effects between MAC and MAIC contributes to understanding the significance of culturally adapting mindfulness training and transnational movement of practices. The findings will assist practitioners in selecting evidence-based protocols tailored to athlete needs and cultural contexts. Systematic review registration Prospero (ID: CRD42023474474).

In mindfulness (MAIC: g = 1.273, p < 0.001; MAC: g = 0.521, p = 0.001), sports performance (MAIC: g = 0.945, p = 0.015; MAC: g = 0.550, p < 0.001), MAC did not provide evidence of improved psychological flexibility (g = 0.076, p = 0.747), while MAIC demonstrated significant benefits (g = 0.964, p < 0.001). Discussion While MAIC is based on MAC, it yields more significant outcomes. This may be the “Insight” component introduced by MAIC, which skillfully integrates Eastern context. The MAIC strategy not only becomes more appropriate for local athletes but also indirectly enhances their mindfulness, athletic performance, and psychological flexibility, resulting from cultural adaptation. The new idea not only solves the culture shock caused by the direct application of Western MAC approach on Chinese athletes, but also provides a new solution to the problem that there is insufficient evidence to support the effect of the MAC approach on “psychological flexibility.” Investigating differential effects between MAC and MAIC contributes to understanding the significance of culturally adapting mindfulness training and transnational movement of practices. The findings will assist practitioners in selecting evidence-based protocols tailored to athlete needs and cultural contexts. Systematic review registration Prospero (ID: CRD42023474474).

stories.hook: ¿Puede la vergüenza destruir el florecimiento personal?
stories.headline: La vergüenza internalizada predice negativamente el florecimiento
stories.finding: En 53 estudiantes de posgrado, la vergüenza internalizada mostró una correlación negativa fuerte con el florecimiento (r = –0.67) y fue el único predictor único significativo en regresión múltiple (β = –0.64, p < .001, R² = 0.45).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que abordar la vergüenza internalizada podría ser clave para mejorar la autoestima y promover el bienestar psicológico en contextos académicos.
stories.paperTitle: The burden of shame: mediating attachment and flourishing in psychodynamic training programs
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Graduate student burnout and mental health struggles have received much attention; however, there has been less focus on graduate student flourishing and the impact of attachment dimensions and internalized shame. Psychodynamic theorists emphasize the importance of addressing shame, as it often influences well-being and interferes with openness and vulnerability. Materials and methods: The current exploratory study explored flourishing in a sample of 53 graduate students enrolled in two Mid-Atlantic psychodynamically oriented professional psychology programs. Participants completed the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale–Short Form (ECR-S), Flourishing Index (FI), and Internalized Shame Scale (ISS). Statistical analyses included Pearson correlations, multiple regression, and path analysis. Results: Pearson correlations revealed that flourishing was significantly negatively related to attachment anxiety (r = −0.35), attachment avoidance (r = −0.33), and internalized shame (r = −0.67). In a simultaneous multiple regression, internalized shame was the only significant unique predictor of flourishing (β = −0.64, p < 0.001; R2 = 0.45). A path analysis revealed that attachment anxiety (β = 0.35) and avoidance (β = 0.42) had significant direct effects on shame, which in turn predicted reduced flourishing (β = −0.64); the indirect effects of anxiety (β = −0.23, p = 0.008) and avoidance (β = −0.27, p = 0.006) on flourishing through shame were significant, whereas the direct effects of attachment on flourishing were not. Conclusions: Results highlight the importance of shame when examining graduate student flourishing and that attachment may relate to well-being through shame-based mechanisms. Self-report measures and sample size are discussed as limitations. Implications for future research, programmatic intervention, and training are addressed.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo el agotamiento impulsa la renuncia silenciosa?
stories.headline: El agotamiento emocional predice la renuncia silenciosa en trabajadores psiquiátricos
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 440 trabajadores de salud psiquiátrica, el agotamiento emocional se asoció positivamente con la renuncia silenciosa (β = 0.228, p < 0.001). El actuar superficial medió parcialmente esa relación (β = 0.116, IC 95 % [0.071, 0.217]), mientras que la expresión natural la medió negativamente (β = 0.056, IC 95 % [0.029, 0.115]).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir sobre el actuar superficial y fomentar la expresión natural puede disminuir la renuncia silenciosa, ofreciendo una vía práctica para mitigar el burnout y retener personal clave en entornos de alta demanda emocional.
stories.paperTitle: Emotional Exhaustion and Quiet Quitting Among Psychiatric Healthcare Workers: The Differential Mediating Roles of Emotional Labor Strategies
stories.originalAbstract: Background/Objectives: Psychiatric healthcare workers (HCWs) face unique emotional demands and may be particularly vulnerable to emotional exhaustion and quiet quitting. This study aimed to examine the association between emotional exhaustion and quiet quitting and the differential mediating roles of emotional labor strategies in this association. Methods: This multicenter cross-sectional study included 440 HCWs from three psychiatric hospitals in Hangzhou, China, between July and August 2025. Emotional exhaustion, emotional labor strategies, and quiet quitting were assessed using validated scales. Correlation, hierarchical regression, mediation, and network analyses were conducted. Results: Emotional exhaustion was positively associated with quiet quitting (β = 0.228, p < 0.001). Surface acting was positively correlated with emotional exhaustion and quiet quitting and partially mediated the association between them (indirect effect: β = 0.116, 95% CI: [0.071, 0.217]). Natural expression was negatively correlated with both emotional exhaustion and quiet quitting and also partially mediated their association (indirect effect: β = 0.056, 95% CI: [0.029, 0.115]). Deep acting was negatively correlated with quiet quitting but showed no significant indirect association. Network analysis identified lack of initiative, emotional exhaustion, and surface acting as central nodes, while emotional exhaustion, surface acting, and lack of motivation emerged as bridge nodes within the network. Conclusions: Emotional labor strategies showed distinct patterns in the association between emotional exhaustion and quiet quitting. Surface acting and natural expression showed significant indirect associations, whereas deep acting did not. These findings highlight the relevance of emotional exhaustion and strategy-specific emotional labor patterns in understanding quiet quitting among psychiatric HCWs.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la falsedad emocional con la pareja dañar el trabajo?
stories.headline: Actuar superficialmente con la pareja aumenta la alienación laboral, especialmente en líderes maquiavélicos
stories.finding: En tres oleadas semanales de 226 líderes estadounidenses, suprimir emociones negativas con la pareja (T1) se relacionó positivamente con la auto‑alienación en el trabajo (T3) mediante la frustración de la necesidad de relación (T2). Este efecto, directo e indirecto, fue más fuerte en líderes con alto maquiavelismo.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que la regulación emocional superficial con la pareja deteriora la identidad laboral y que el maquiavelismo la intensifica, indicando la necesidad de intervenciones que fomenten la expresión auténtica y consideren rasgos de personalidad en la formación de líderes.
stories.paperTitle: The nonwork-work spillover effects of leaders' spouse-directed surface acting: implications for self-alienation at work and the role of Machiavellianism
stories.originalAbstract: Purpose Guided by the work-home resources model while integrating basic needs theory, the present study examined how spouse-directed surface acting in the nonwork domain spills over into the work domain. Design/methodology/approach Three time-lagged waves of weekly data from 226 US leaders were analyzed using first-stage moderated mediation analysis with 5,000 bootstrapped resamples in R software. Findings Results from the bootstrapped moderated mediation model revealed that suppressing negative emotions with one's spouse at Time 1 was positively linked to self-alienation at work at Time 3 via the frustration of relatedness needs with one's spouse at Time 2. Moreover, this indirect effect (as well the direct effect between suppressing negative emotions and relatedness frustration) was, contravening our predictions, stronger for leaders higher in Machiavellianism. Originality/value This research is among the first to document the negative spillover effects of spouse-directed surface acting, revealing that suppressing negative emotions may be a catalyst for such spillover. Furthermore, our work builds upon extant knowledge of Machiavellianism in intimate partnerships, suggesting that while Machs may surface act with their partners more, they may particularly be vulnerable to the effects of negative emotion suppression.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la IA persuadir moralmente como un humano?
stories.headline: La IA ejerce una persuasión moral comparable a la humana en dilemas éticos
stories.finding: En nueve dilemas sacrificiales, el consejo generado por IA modificó las decisiones morales al mismo nivel que el consejo humano. El consejo de tipo deontológico incrementó significativamente las elecciones deontológicas, mientras que el consejo utilitarista mostró escasa influencia persuasiva.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la IA puede actuar como un heurístico de persuasión moral, lo que implica que los diseñadores de sistemas inteligentes deben considerar su potencial influencia en juicios éticos y en la formación de normas sociales.
stories.paperTitle: What Should (A)I Do? The Heuristic Role of Artificial Advice in Moral Decision-Making
stories.journal: University of Regensburg Publication Server (University of Regensburg)
stories.originalAbstract: This dissertation investigates how Artificial Intelligence (AI) affects moral decision-making across four empirical studies, examining the extent, conditions, and mechanisms of AI- induced moral persuasion. Building on previous work, the overarching aim was to determine whether AI-generated advice affects moral decisions to the same extent as human advice, and whether advice generally functions as a source-independent heuristic cue in moral decision-making. Across four empirical studies, we systematically varied dilemma difficulty, ecological validity, social proximity, conflicting advice, and the temporal order of decision and advice to test the robustness and generalizability of artificial moral persuasion. Study 1 provided the first systematic demonstration that AI-generated advice affects moral decision-making to a comparable extent as human advice. Across nine sacrificial moral dilemmas of varying difficulty, advice was presented with explanatory context rather than simple imperatives. Deontological advice reliably increased deontological choices, whereas utilitarian advice showed little persuasive effect. Importantly, AI- and human advice exerted comparable influence, indicating that advisor source did not meaningfully affect advice use even in complex, morally charged situations. Study 2 replicated the findings of Study 1 and extended them to everyday moral decision- making while experimentally manipulating social proximity across twenty dilemmas. Both altruistic and egoistic advice significantly affected moral decisions, and AI-generated advice again proved to be as persuasive as human advice. Although social proximity influenced the overall strength of persuasion, it did not introduce systematic differences between advisors. These results suggest that everyday moral decision-making is similarly susceptible to advice, consistent with its use as a heuristic cue rather than as a source-dependent signal. Study 3 further clarified the underlying psychological processes involved in the heuristic use of advice by presenting participants with simultaneous AI- and human advice that was either convergent or conflicting across sacrificial and everyday moral dilemmas. When advice was convergent, participants predominantly followed the recommended option; when advice conflicted, decisions were guided by advice content and perceived helpfulness rather than by advisor. This pattern indicates that both AI- and human advice are primarily used heuristically. Study 4 extended the findings of the previous studies to situations involving pre-existing personal positions. Participants first made initial moral decisions and subsequently received AI- or human advice before deciding again. Decision stability declined substantially when advice opposed the initial choice, particularly for utilitarian judgments in sacrificial dilemmas and for everyday decisions more broadly. AI- and human advice again produced comparable effects, and perceived helpfulness reliably predicted whether participants revised their earlier decisions. Across all four studies, no meaningful differences emerged between the persuasive impact of AI and human advisors. Instead, moral persuasion was consistently driven by normative alignment, subjective usefulness, and contextual features of the dilemma. These findings suggest that artificial advisors can function as potent sources of social influence and that individuals readily adopt AI-generated advice as an effort-reducing heuristic in moral decision- making. The dissertation concludes by discussing implications for moral psychology, human-AI interaction, and the societal challenges posed by increasingly advisory-capable AI systems.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una app digital acelerar la pérdida de peso en jóvenes?
stories.headline: Programa digital de autorregulación reduce peso y medidas corporales en adultos jóvenes
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado de 12 semanas, el programa digital redujo 1,90 kg el peso corporal, 0,45 kg/m² el IMC y 2,10 cm la circunferencia de cintura (p ≤ .01). Tres meses después de retirar el dispositivo, la cintura siguió disminuyendo 0,8 cm (p ≈ .05).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que una intervención digital basada en autorregulación puede generar pérdidas de peso clínicamente relevantes y efectos sostenidos, ofreciendo una herramienta escalable para combatir la obesidad en jóvenes adultos.
stories.paperTitle: Improving weight loss among young adults with excess body weight using a theory-driven digital self-regulation program: a randomized controlled trial
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND: Lifestyle modification is fundamental for obesity management but remains challenging. PURPOSE: To test the effectiveness of a 12-week digital self-regulation program on improving weight loss and self-regulation among young adults. METHODS: A 2-arm parallel 1:1 randomized controlled trial was conducted. Participants were randomly assigned to either the intervention or the control group. The primary outcomes were weight and self-regulation, while the secondary outcomes were nutrition knowledge, eating phenotypes, overeating habits, anxiety, and depression. All data were collected at weeks 0, 12, and 24. RESULTS: We showed the effectiveness of a digital commitment device on body weight (-1.90 ± 6.4 kg, P = .002), body mass index (-0.45 ± 2.0 kg/m2, P = .002), waist circumference (-2.10 ± 12.1 cm, P = .01), basal metabolic rate (-20.30 ± 118.6 kcal, P = .04) and body roundness index (-0.17 ± 0.6, P = .014). Interventional effects were sustained for waist circumference (-0.8 ± 2.8 cm, P = .05) and body roundness index (-0.07 ± 0.36, P = .047) 3 months beyond removing access to the commitment device. General improvements in nutrition knowledge, psychological flexibility, uncontrolled eating, and anxiety were found among both groups, but differences were only significant for depression scores (-0.06 ± 1.5, P = .032) and eating self-regulation (0.16 ± 0.54, P = .003). CONCLUSION: This study showed the potential of a digital commitment device in improving eating self-regulation, anthropometry, and mental wellness for scalable implementation in the community setting. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT05969639).

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta el duelo mediático a la salud mental?
stories.headline: El duelo directo y la exposición mediática aumentan ansiedad y depresión durante la pandemia
stories.finding: En 171 adultos, el duelo directo por pérdida de seres queridos mostró un impacto extremadamente severo en ansiedad, estrés y miedo al COVID‑19. Una alta exposición mediática se vinculó a mayores niveles de depresión y estrés, incluso sin pérdidas personales.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta a profesionales de salud mental sobre la necesidad de evaluar tanto el duelo directo como la exposición a noticias de muerte, pues ambas aumentan síntomas de ansiedad y depresión, orientando intervenciones preventivas durante crisis sanitarias.
stories.paperTitle: Direct Losses and Media Exposure to Death: The Long-Term Effect of Mourning during the COVID-19 Pandemic
stories.originalAbstract: Background: The social distancing policies adopted during the COVID-19 pandemic forced many individuals to confront their mortality and worry about losing loved ones, making it impossible to say goodbye to them properly. Those not directly experiencing loss were inundated with information about COVID-19-related deaths throughout social media, leading to vicarious grief. This study delved into the long-term effects of direct and vicarious mourning on people’s mental health during the COVID-19 pandemic. Method: A sample of 171 adults (65% female) aged 19–66 years (Mage = 25.8, SD = 8.57) voluntarily participated in an online survey assessing self-reported psychological measures of complicated grief, stress, depression, dispositional neuroticism, trait anxiety, and situational anxiety. Results: MANOVAs revealed that direct mourning experiences had an extremely severe impact on anxiety, stress, and fear of COVID-19, and a moderate effect on those without personal losses. Indeed, participants reporting high media exposure showed higher scores of depression and stress. Conclusions: Findings from the current study displayed that during the COVID-19 pandemic, people engaged more in proximal defenses than distal ones, taking health-protective measures, experiencing increased anxiety levels toward virus infection, and feeling distressed. Additionally, vicarious mourning was more strongly associated with depression due to emotional empathy with others.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta el ADHD al embarazo y lactancia?
stories.headline: Mujeres con ADHD presentan más preocupaciones y peor experiencia de lactancia
stories.finding: El estudio comparó a 198 mujeres con diagnóstico de ADHD y 152 sin diagnóstico durante el periodo perinatal. Las mujeres con ADHD mostraron mayor preocupación durante el embarazo (p < .001) y una peor experiencia en la dimensión de estilo de vida de la lactancia (p = .020).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta sobre la necesidad de adaptar la atención prenatal y el apoyo a la lactancia en mujeres con ADHD, considerando su mayor vulnerabilidad a la ansiedad y a dificultades en el cuidado del bebé.
stories.paperTitle: Differences in perinatal experiences in females with and without ADHD: a cross-sectional study considering diagnostic status and traits
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Background Attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) may be impacted by sex hormones but there is little research investigating the experiences of ADHD at times of known hormonal change such as pregnancy. The current study aimed to better understand how females with ADHD experience antenatal care, pregnancy and breastfeeding. Methods Females in the perinatal period reporting a diagnosis of ADHD ( N = 198) were compared to those without a diagnosis ( N = 152) using an online survey assessing pregnancy worries, breastfeeding experience and satisfaction with antenatal care alongside indicators of attendance of antenatal care appointments in the first trimester and across the entire pregnancy. Regression analyses compared the two groups with additional exploratory analyses comparing those with ADHD on and off medication during periods of pregnancy and breastfeeding. Trait-based comparisons were also made to test whether ADHD-traits, independent of diagnosis, were associated with these factors. Results Having an ADHD diagnosis was associated with greater pregnancy worries ( p <.001) and poorer experiences of the lifestyle dimension of breastfeeding ( p =.020) compared to those without a diagnosis. ADHD traits were associated with worries independently of diagnosis ( p <.001, p <.002, respectively) whilst only traits were associated with breastfeeding lifestyle ( p =.006). There were no group differences or traits relationships for antenatal care service satisfaction ( p >.05) whilst ceiling effects on attendance prevented meaningful analysis. Exploratory analysis indicated no effects of medication on pregnancy worries or service satisfaction ( p >.05) whilst medication during breastfeeding may improve lifestyle aspects ( p =.046), but caution is needed due to the small sample. Discussion Pregnancy worries were higher in those with concurrent health conditions and ADHD whilst experiences of breastfeeding were generally associated with fewer worries. Breastfeeding experiences related to infant satisfaction and maternal enjoyment were associated only with specific pregnancy and breastfeeding experiences and not related to ADHD diagnosis or traits. However, the experiences related to the emotional and physical toll of breastfeeding and sense of their own body did differ with worse experiences for those with ADHD or high ADHD traits. Service satisfaction appeared unrelated to ADHD diagnosis or traits. Attendance at appointments was consistently high preventing meaningful analysis. No effects of medication were found during pregnancy in the exploratory analyses, although medication during breastfeeding was associated with slightly better experiences but the sample size was small, limiting the conclusions that can be drawn. Conclusion These findings indicate that females with ADHD may have different perinatal experiences to those without ADHD with greater pregnancy worries and poorer experiences of some aspects of breastfeeding associated with both ADHD diagnosis and ADHD traits.

Conclusion These findings indicate that females with ADHD may have different perinatal experiences to those without ADHD with greater pregnancy worries and poorer experiences of some aspects of breastfeeding associated with both ADHD diagnosis and ADHD traits.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el apoyo escolar mejorar el bienestar de estudiantes vulnerables?
stories.headline: Apoyo de personal escolar aumenta significativamente el bienestar psicológico de estudiantes con relaciones sociales pobres.
stories.finding: En un estudio con 17 126 adolescentes, niveles más altos de apoyo del personal escolar se asociaron con mayores puntuaciones en bienestar psicológico, optimismo, autoestima y satisfacción vital. La relación fue más pronunciada en estudiantes que experimentaban acoso escolar, indicando una moderación por la exposición al bullying.
stories.takeaway: El hallazgo subraya la importancia de fortalecer la relación docente‑estudiante como estrategia preventiva para mejorar la salud mental de jóvenes con relaciones sociales deficientes, y sugiere que la intervención debe adaptarse a contextos de acoso escolar.
stories.paperTitle: The Association Between School Staff Support and Wellbeing for Students With Poor Quality Social Relationships
stories.originalAbstract: ABSTRACT Students with poor quality relationships typically report lower wellbeing than their peers. Developmental theory suggests that support from school staff may play a compensatory role for these vulnerable learners, but current evidence is meagre. Using data from N = 17,126 adolescents from the #BeeWell study in Greater Manchester, England, we fitted a series of linear regression models to estimate the association between school staff support and psychological wellbeing; optimism; self‐esteem; and, life satisfaction (controlling for prior levels of these outcomes). These models were subsequently extended to explore whether the association between school staff support and wellbeing varies based on students' level of parent/carer support, peer support, and/or exposure to bullying. Analyses revealed that higher levels of school staff support are significantly associated with higher levels of all four student wellbeing outcomes. Moderation analyses revealed a complex picture, with the nature and magnitude of effects varying by relationship and wellbeing outcome. For example, for self‐esteem, the association with school staff support is stronger for students who are exposed to bullying. These results highlight the importance of having supportive school staff for promoting student wellbeing and suggest that increasing school staff support is a potentially useful mechanism for bolstering the wellbeing of vulnerable students (e.g., those who are bullied).

stories.hook: ¿Puede la eritropoyetina remodelar la inhibición cerebral?
stories.headline: La eritropoyetina reduce la potencia inhibitoria de interneuronas hipocampales
stories.finding: El estudio analizó ~12,000 núcleos de transcriptoma unicelular del hipocampo de ratón, identificando 15 subtipos de interneuronas. La administración de eritropoyetina recombinante humana modificó la expresión génica, disminuyendo la complejidad dendrítica y la conectividad sináptica de subpoblaciones específicas, alterando su plasticidad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la eritropoyetina puede reequilibrar la relación excitación‑inhibición en el hipocampo, ofreciendo una vía potencial para intervenir en trastornos psiquiátricos caracterizados por disfunción sináptica, como esquizofrenia o autismo.
stories.paperTitle: Erythropoietin restrains the inhibitory potential of interneurons in the mouse hippocampus
stories.originalAbstract: Severe psychiatric illnesses, for instance schizophrenia, and affective diseases or autism spectrum disorders, have been associated with cognitive impairment and perturbed excitatory-inhibitory balance in the brain. Effects in juvenile mice can elucidate how erythropoietin (EPO) might aid in rectifying hippocampal transcriptional networks and synaptic structures of pyramidal lineages, conceivably explaining mitigation of neuropsychiatric diseases. An imminent conundrum is how EPO restores synapses by involving interneurons. By analyzing ~12,000 single-nuclei transcriptomic data, we generated a comprehensive molecular atlas of hippocampal interneurons, resolved into 15 interneuron subtypes. Next, we studied molecular alterations upon recombinant human (rh)EPO and saw that gene expression changes relate to synaptic structure, trans-synaptic signaling and intracellular catabolic pathways. Putative ligand-receptor interactions between pyramidal and inhibitory neurons, regulating synaptogenesis, are altered upon rhEPO. An array of in/ex vivo experiments confirms that specific interneuronal populations exhibit reduced dendritic complexity, synaptic connectivity, and changes in plasticity-related molecules. Metabolism and inhibitory potential of interneuron subgroups are compromised, leading to greater excitability of pyramidal neurons. To conclude, improvement by rhEPO of neuropsychiatric phenotypes may partly owe to restrictive control over interneurons, facilitating re-connectivity and synapse development.
